source.notes: h=60 W/m2K is a mid-range estimate for a moderately ducted FSAE rotor at autocross speeds; sweep 30-150. Emissivity 0.55 for oxidized steel (sweep 0.3-0.8). Ambient 35 C and allowable 500 C tie to the H38 pad cap (data/materials/pad_compounds.yaml). vane_area_multiplier=1.0 treats the rotor as solid (conservative); raise toward ~1.8-2.4 once vented-vane area is known. Air props at ~35 C, 1 atm.

assumptions.source: solid-rotor conservative placeholder; CAD vane area TODO

Fraction of friction heat entering the rotor (remainder to the pads). 1.0 keeps the conservative all-heat-to-rotor lumped assumption (spec 20.1); thermal effusivity ratios for a steel rotor against an organic pad suggest 0.85-0.95. Confirm with pad-material effusivity data.
